selection: validation connected-block-equal weighted RMSE; lower alpha breaks exact ties
training_weights: equal total weight per inherited training connected block
validation_weights: equal total weight per inherited validation connected block
feature_fit: DictVectorizer fitted on train only; validation/test unseen categories ignored; no other normalization
assay_feature: instrument from verified primary_assay for development; frozen instrument for test; missing or unassigned instrument remains explicit
test_weights: equal source total; equal lineage within source; equal observation within lineage
primary: 14 metric_role=primary observations; original15 preserved; excluded extrapolated S8WT/A11 sensitivity only
sensitivity: all15; each source omitted in turn for metric sensitivity only, never refit
acceptance_predeclared: primary source/lineage-weighted RMSE and MAE both strictly lower than train-mean comparator AND RMSE lower in all3 leave-one-source-out metric subsets; no significance or clinical claim
uncertainty: 3 source components insufficient for precise population CI; no bootstrap CI or p-value asserted
test_access_policy: exclusive persisted ledger before reading test labels; no new fits on this profile after test access; no retry/overwrite of completed output
